title: Compatible stalk algebra maps for a cartesian square
statement: For a cartesian square of schemes and a point z of the upper-left scheme, the stalk maps from the two factors to the upper-left stalk are algebra maps over the base stalk, agree with the displayed projection stalk maps, and have commuting images.

proof.text: Apply Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_comp twice and Scheme.Hom.stalkMap_congr_hom to sq.w. This gives equality between f.stalkMap(g′ z) followed by g′.stalkMap z and the transported base stalk map followed by g.stalkMap(f′ z) and f′.stalkMap z. Regard g′.stalkMap z as an algebra homomorphism over the composite R-to-C map; its scalar compatibility is reflexivity. Regard f′.stalkMap z as an algebra homomorphism using the preceding equality evaluated on a scalar, with the opposite orientation. Both underlying ring maps are unchanged, so the two restrictions are reflexivity. Their images commute by Commute.all since C is commutative.

theorem exists_stalk_algebra_maps (z : X') :
    letI := leftAlgebra f g' z
    letI := rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq z
    letI := (f.stalkMap (g' z) ≫ g'.stalkMap z).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ l : A g' z →ₐ[R f g' z] C z,
      ∃ r : B f' z →ₐ[R f g' z] C z,
        (∀ a, l a = (g'.stalkMap z).hom a) ∧
        (∀ b, r b = (f'.stalkMap z).hom b) ∧
        ∀ a b, Commute (l a) (r b)
